heads.t: 聚焦新加坡/新加坡海水淡化新突破 陶瓷薄膜省電省空間 海邊看似源源不絕的大水，要端上餐桌變身清甜飲用水，關鍵全在第一關。海水踏入淡化廠後，第一步必須徹底剔除懸浮物與各式雜質，避免這些髒污破壞後續高精密淡化薄膜。過往這道防禦工程程序繁瑣，必須分拆成三道關卡層層把關。新加坡國家水務局近期啟動一項關鍵試驗，引進日本最新陶瓷薄膜系統，試圖將原本綿長繁複的三衝程過濾簡化為單一關卡，一口氣實現減碳省電與空間極致利用。 6 分鐘前｜國際 聚焦新加坡/新加坡海水淡化新突破 陶瓷薄膜省電省空間 6 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: Focus on Singapore/Singapore Water Desalinization New Breaking Point. Once seawater enters the desalination plant, the first step must be to completely remove the floats and all sorts of obscurities so that they do not destroy the stains and then decompose the thin film. In the past, the defense process has been cumbersome and has to be broken down into three levels. Singapore's National Water Authority has recently launched a critical experiment to introduce Japan's latest ceramic film system, attempting to streamline the already complex three-step filtering process into a single level, with a breath of carbon reduction saving electricity and space. Six minutes ago, the international community focused on a new breakthrough in the desalination of Singapore/Singapore.
